definitions.gloss: exchange meeting, social gathering, networking event, mixer
definitions.explanation: A gathering organized for people to meet, interact, and share ideas or experiences. Used for cultural exchange events, professional networking, community meetups, and similar social occasions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{交流会|こうりゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I participated in an international exchange event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交流会|こうりゅうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I made new friends at a community social gathering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交流会|こうりゅうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧になっている。
examples.english: An exchange event for international and Japanese students is held monthly, providing a good opportunity to discuss cultural differences.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧ (exchange, interaction) and ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (meeting, gathering). Very common in Japanese social and professional life. Can range from casual neighborhood get-togethers to formal professional networking events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交流会|こうりゅうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold an exchange event
- {交流会|こうりゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to attend an exchange event
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{交流会|こうりゅうかい}: international exchange meeting
- {異業種|いぎょうしゅ}{交流会|こうりゅうかい}: cross-industry networking event
- ⟦{親睦|しんぼく}→親睦：09128_shinboku⟧{交流会|こうりゅうかい}: social get-together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{懇親会|こんしんかい}→懇親会：17926_konshinkai⟧: social gathering, reception — typically with food and drinks, more party-like
- ⟦{親睦会|しんぼくかい}→親睦会：14968_shinbokukai⟧: friendship gathering — emphasis on deepening bonds between existing members
- ⟦{勉強会|べんきょうかい}→勉強会：23197_benkyoukai⟧: study group — focused on learning rather than socializing
